newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-DAY SEVEN SNIPPETS FROM ROLAND GARROS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-DAY SEVEN SNIPPETS FROM ROLAND GARROS.

text.p: A brief selection of highlights from the seventh day of the French Open:

Best quote - "I'm not Mother Teresa, I don't care. I'm not here to do charity work for anybody." Switzerland's Marc Rosset, asked if he felt sympathy for his fellow players on a windy day at Roland Garros.

Stat of the day - 29. The number of years since the last Brazilian reached the quarter-finals at the French Open. Gustavo Kuerten will be the first Brazilian since Tomas Koch in 1968 if he can win the fifth and deciding set of his match with Andrei Medvedev, suspended on Sunday due to darkness.

Black day - Marcelo Rios will be glad to know there are no more Black brothers lurking around the back courts of Roland Garros after being extended to five sets in his first two matches by Zimbabwe siblings Wayne and Byron. Younger sister Cara, however, is still around, trying to make a similar impression in the junior competition.
